heals.title: Adafruit (verified)
heals.whatBroke: 53 of 836 products missing price; stock status was noisy variant/description text instead of a clean enum
heals.outcome: 662 products (listing coverage dropped vs 836). **0/662 missing price.** Stock is a clean enum on every row: `{in stock: 276, out of stock: 74, unknown: 312}`. No leftover variant-blob stock strings.

heals.title: The Pi Hut (verified)
heals.whatBroke: currency symbol returned as repeated `£` characters (`££££££££`) instead of a single `£` plus numeric price
heals.outcome: 48/48 rows have a single `£`, 0 repeated-pound rows, 29 distinct prices.

heals.title: Pimoroni attempt 2 (verified)
heals.whatBroke: names still used variant labels after attempt 1; currency was already a single `£`
heals.outcome: 320 products, currency still single `£` on all rows. Names now look like product titles (`Raspberry Pi 5 Official Case with Fan`, `HyperPixel 4.0 Square…`) instead of plug-region / size variants.

heals.title: Pimoroni attempt 1 (currency fixed; names still broken)
heals.whatBroke: currency returned as repeated `£` characters (`££££`); some product names grabbed variant option text instead of the base product name
heals.outcome: **currency fixed** - 320/320 rows have a single `£`, 0 repeated-pound rows. **Names not fixed** - still variant labels (`United Kingdom`, `4.0"`, `No Disk`, `Red/White`). Follow-up heal targets the title on the card.

heals.title: SparkFun attempt 2 (verified)
heals.whatBroke: listing run still cloned one price/stock onto every card after attempt 1
heals.outcome: 120 products, 84 distinct prices, stock mix `{In stock: 58, Out of stock: 41, Discontinued: 13, Backorder: 8}`. Neighbor rows now differ (`$50` / In stock vs `$114.95` / Discontinued vs `$99.95` / Discontinued vs `$149.95` / Out of stock).
